theory_black_holes.md
nodes.summary: Complete self-contained derivation of black hole theory from first principles: Schwarzschild solution via Birkhoff assumptions, full LaTeX field-equation chain with explicit SI units and (-,+,+,+) signature.

nodes.name: theory_kerr_newman.md
nodes.summary: Kerr-Newman rotating charged black hole: Einstein-Maxwell action and the full Boyer-Lindquist metric with mass M, spin a, charge Q parameters.

nodes.name: theory_kerr_newman_adm.md
nodes.summary: ADM decomposition of GR (lapse/shift) and a complete derivation of the ADM mass, angular momentum, and charge for Kerr-Newman spacetimes.

nodes.name: theory_reissner_nordstrom.md
nodes.summary: Reissner-Nordstrom static charged black hole: Einstein-Maxwell action, coupled field equations, and electromagnetic stress-energy derivation.

nodes.name: theory_christoffel_kerr.md
nodes.summary: Complete derivation of all 48 non-zero Christoffel symbols of the Kerr metric in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates, computed via the inverse metric and its derivatives.

nodes.name: theory_geodesic_equations.md
nodes.summary: Geodesic equations for Schwarzschild and Kerr: Lagrangian derivation, Hamilton-Jacobi separability, Carter constant, effective potentials, orbit classification, and pericenter advance.

nodes.name: theory_raychaudhuri.md
nodes.summary: Raychaudhuri equation for null and timelike congruences derived from geodesic deviation; expansion/shear/vorticity terms, focusing theorem, and Penrose-Hawking singularity theorem connections.

nodes.name: theory_fisher_matrix.md
nodes.summary: Fisher information matrix for gravitational-wave parameter estimation: waveform derivatives w.r.t. masses/spins, SNR inner-product integrals, covariance matrix, and BH-binary degeneracy analysis.

nodes.name: theory_bh_perturbation.md
nodes.summary: Black hole perturbation theory: linearized fluctuations over Schwarzschild/Kerr backgrounds separating into decoupled master equations, with the full metric setup in LaTeX.

nodes.name: theory_white_holes.md
nodes.summary: White hole complete theoretical treatment: time-reversed Schwarzschild interpretation, the deceptive metric invariance under time reversal, maximal-extension causal structure, and observational signatures.

nodes.name: theory_wormholes.md
nodes.summary: Wormhole theory derivation: historical Einstein-Rosen bridge (1935) through Morris-Thorne traversable metrics, all in LaTeX with derivations.

nodes.name: early_smbh_growth.md
nodes.summary: Early supermassive black-hole growth: evidence ledger for high-z quasars and JWST AGN (J0313-1806, CEERS 1019, GN-z11, UHZ1), Eddington-limited growth algebra, seed feasibility, and explicit caveats that the selection is not a complete or statistically representative sample.

nodes.name: quantum_gravity.md
nodes.summary: Quantum gravity module: why GR and QFT conflict, Planck-scale dimensional derivation, gravitational EFT as controlled low-energy theory below its cutoff, candidate UV approaches (string theory, LQG, asymptotic safety, causal sets), with strict measured/derived/illustration evidence labels.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview of the exotic-compact-objects flagship: scope (black holes, wormholes, white holes), data sources (GWOSC GWTC, HEASARC, theoretical grids), and the directory structure of data/models/notebooks/premium.

nodes.name: THEORY.md
nodes.summary: Compact complete theory in LaTeX: GR foundations (metric, Christoffel, Riemann, Ricci, Einstein equations) followed by the Schwarzschild solution and companion solutions.

nodes.name: summary.md
nodes.summary: Project summary roll-up: catalog counts (391 GWTC events, HEASARC CSVs), the implemented model inventory (Schwarzschild/Kerr/Morris-Thorne/white-hole/Hawking), the notebook list, and next steps.

nodes.name: gwosc_latest.md
nodes.summary: GWOSC snapshot status report: 391 GWTC records from the GWOSC event API, with the explicit reminder that a merger catalog is not a black-hole census.

nodes.name: compute_data_report.md
nodes.summary: Report of compute_with_data.py runs: GWTC chirp-mass and redshift recomputation deviations, mass-gap candidates, ISCO/Hawking remnant physics, and detection-band strain quicklooks for GW170817/GW190814/GW190521.

nodes.name: derivations_report.md
nodes.summary: Auto-generated verification report: every symbolic derivation from models/derivations.py executed with SymPy (each check reduces to an identity or strict inequality), plus astropy/scipy numeric spot checks; one PASS entry per derivation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init: re-exports the equations symbols so users can import from the models package directly.

nodes.name: equations.py
nodes.summary: Core astropy-unit equations for exotic compact objects: Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, ISCO and photon-sphere radii, Kerr horizon/ergosphere, Morris-Thorne wormhole shape/redshift/metric components, and white-hole constructions.

nodes.name: formulas.py
nodes.summary: Extended numeric formulas with astropy units: exact Kerr ISCO, ISCO orbital frequency, Eddington luminosity and accretion rate, and GW chirp mass / symmetric mass ratio / delta — each function cites the symbolic derivation that backs it.

nodes.name: derivations.py
nodes.summary: Fully symbolic Sympy derivations backing every formula in the project: Christoffel symbols, Ricci tensor, photon sphere, ISCO, Hawking radiation, wormhole flare-out; each derivation carries explicit checks and entry point run_all() yields DerivationResult dicts consumed by scripts/verify_formulas.py.

nodes.name: schwarzschild_radius
nodes.summary: Computes Rs = 2GM/c^2 in kilometers with astropy constants.

nodes.name: hawking_temperature
nodes.summary: Computes T_H = hbar c^3 / (8 pi G M kB) for a black hole.

nodes.name: morris_thorne_metric_components
nodes.summary: Returns (g_tt, g_rr) for the Morris-Thorne demo wormhole metric from shape and redshift functions.

nodes.name: kerr_isco_radius
nodes.summary: Exact Kerr ISCO radius via the Bardeen-Press-Teukolsky 1972 Z1/Z2 formula, prograde or retrograde.

nodes.name: eddington_luminosity
nodes.summary: Computes the Eddington luminosity limit 4 pi G M m_p c / sigma_T.

nodes.name: gw_chirp_mass
nodes.summary: Recomputes the chirp mass (m1 m2)^(3/5)/(m1+m2)^(1/5) used to cross-check GWTC catalog values.

nodes.name: run_all
nodes.summary: Entry point returning the full list of symbolic derivation results with formula, steps, and pass/fail checks; consumed by verify_formulas.py.

nodes.name: 01_exotic_compact_objects_fundamentals.ipynb
nodes.summary: First theoretical model notebook: Schwarzschild/Kerr/Morris-Thorne basics with the first-pass equations, designed around GWTC and HEASARC snapshots.

nodes.name: 02_extended_models.ipynb
nodes.summary: Extended models notebook: Kerr ISCO vs spin, effective potentials, Morris-Thorne flare-out and embedding, Hawking radiation power/lifetime, and white-hole analogs.

nodes.name: 03_data_exploration.ipynb
nodes.summary: Data exploration of downloaded catalogs: GWOSC GWTC events and HEASARC compact-object CSVs joined into mass distributions.

nodes.name: 04_white_hole_instability.ipynb
nodes.summary: White hole instability notebook: conceptual notes plus a toy exponential decay model of an unstable white hole.

nodes.name: 05_equation_derivations.ipynb
nodes.summary: Equation derivations notebook: step-by-step symbolic (SymPy) and numeric (NumPy/SciPy) verification of key equations with intermediate steps.

nodes.name: 06_visual_models.ipynb
nodes.summary: Visual models notebook: Plotly 3D wormhole embedding and Kerr ergosphere views, exported as figures/ HTML for phone viewing.

nodes.name: 07_geodesics.ipynb
nodes.summary: Geodesic simulation notebook: EinsteinPy timelike geodesic integration for Schwarzschild and Kerr orbits.

nodes.name: 08_sympy_christoffel.ipynb
nodes.summary: Notebook computing Christoffel symbols of the Schwarzschild and Morris-Thorne metrics symbolically with SymPy.

nodes.name: 09_white_hole_extended.ipynb
nodes.summary: White hole extended notebook: instability, a toy energy-release model, and candidate observational signatures.

nodes.name: 10_complete_theory.ipynb
nodes.summary: Complete theory notebook: the full theoretical framework with derivations, explanations, and consistency checks as a readable theory document with runnable code.

nodes.name: 11_data_synthesis.ipynb
nodes.summary: Data synthesis notebook: combining GWOSC events, AGN reverberation masses, and dynamically discovered stellar black holes into one population picture.

nodes.name: 12_advanced_models.ipynb
nodes.summary: Advanced models notebook: Penrose process energy extraction, superradiance, and Kerr phenomena.

nodes.name: 13_white_hole_deep_dive.ipynb
nodes.summary: White hole deep dive: maximal Kruskal extension geometry, instability, and possible observable signatures.

nodes.name: 14_rebound_nbody.ipynb
nodes.summary: REBOUND N-body simulation notebook (fast-run profile): orbital dynamics around compact objects.

nodes.name: 15_einsteinpy_geodesics.ipynb
nodes.summary: EinsteinPy geodesics notebook (fast-run profile): orbital integration around compact objects.

nodes.name: 16_yt_cosmology.ipynb
nodes.summary: yt cosmological-simulation notebook (fast-run profile): volumetric cosmology visualization.

nodes.name: 17_gw_analysis.ipynb
nodes.summary: Gravitational-wave analysis notebook (fast-run profile): waveform loading and matched-filtering basics.

nodes.name: 18_ml_astronomy.ipynb
nodes.summary: Machine-learning in astronomy notebook (fast-run profile): classification/regression applied to compact-object data.

nodes.name: 19_gw_strain_analysis.ipynb
nodes.summary: FITS-based gravitational-wave strain notebook: a reproducible signal-analysis workflow over downloaded strain files.

nodes.name: 20_gwtc_remnant_catalog.ipynb
nodes.summary: GWTC remnant catalog notebook (Czech UI): builds the catalog of the 20 most recent merger remnants with derived ISCO/Hawking quantities.

nodes.name: 21_agn_mass_catalog.ipynb
nodes.summary: AGN supermassive black-hole mass catalog notebook: literature reverberation-mass compilation with upper/lower error columns kept distinct.

nodes.name: 22_blackcat_dynamical_catalog.ipynb
nodes.summary: Published BlackCAT dynamical black-hole systems notebook: presents the joined VizieR tables without converting limits to detections.

nodes.name: 23_early_smbh_growth.ipynb
nodes.summary: Early supermassive black-hole evidence notebook: high-z observations, cosmic ages from Planck 2018, symbolic+numeric growth checks, and 30k-draw conditional growth scenarios (seed 20261019), with the selection explicitly labeled non-representative.

nodes.name: 24_quantum_gravity.ipynb
nodes.summary: Quantum gravity notebook: Planck scales, gravitational EFT, and evidence levels with measured/derived/illustration labels.

nodes.name: add_bh_derived_quantities.py
nodes.summary: Adds SI/astrophysical derived quantities with astropy units to the processed catalogs while keeping source catalog values intact.

nodes.name: build_agn_reverberation_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Generates a reproducible Plotly dashboard for AGN reverberation masses from data/processed into premium/figures/.

nodes.name: build_blackcat_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Builds the BlackCAT dynamical-mass dashboard, plotting observed masses without converting upper/lower limits to detections.

nodes.name: build_gwtc_remnant_dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Builds an interactive dashboard from the curated recent GWTC remnant sample into premium/figures/.

nodes.name: build_theoretical_data.py
nodes.summary: Builds theoretical/synthetic datasets for black holes, wormholes, and white holes (constants, mass/throat grids) with astropy units.

nodes.name: compute_with_data.py
nodes.summary: Computes physics with the downloaded and synthetic data: (1) GWTC 391-event reconciliation recomputing chirp masses and redshifts vs catalog values, mass-gap candidate extraction; (2) strain quicklook band-power checks on marquee events; (3) SXS waveform characterization; writes results/*.csv/json and reports/compute_data_report.md.

nodes.name: create_animations.py
nodes.summary: Creates advanced executable animations for exotic compact objects: Plotly interactive HTML and matplotlib MP4/GIF for BH particle orbits, Kerr ergosphere, wormhole embedding, white-hole decay, and CMB spectrum.

nodes.name: download_blackcat.py
nodes.summary: Fetches the published BlackCAT dynamical sample and related VizieR tables.

nodes.name: download_eht.py
nodes.summary: Downloads EHT (Event Horizon Telescope) parameters and visibility data for M87* and Sgr A*, including synthetic visibility generation and a summary.

nodes.name: download_gaia_dr3.py
nodes.summary: Downloads Gaia DR3 black-hole candidate systems (astrometric binaries, known BH systems, wide binaries) via astroquery.

nodes.name: download_gwb.py
nodes.summary: Downloads gravitational-wave background datasets: NANOGrav 15-year, EPTA/PPTA/IPTA DR2 spectra, posterior samples, and Hellings-Downs correlations.

nodes.name: download_gwosc.py
nodes.summary: Downloads a GWOSC GWTC compact-binary catalog snapshot into data/raw as SQLite/CSV with fetch logging and figures.

nodes.name: download_gwosc_o4.py
nodes.summary: Downloads LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA O4 event metadata and 4-kHz strain HDF5 files for GWTC-3/O4 events via GWOSC.

nodes.name: download_heasarc.py
nodes.summary: Downloads HEASARC catalogs relevant to compact objects (XRB, M87, Sgr A* region, ULX) via TAP into CSV.

nodes.name: download_planck.py
nodes.summary: Downloads Planck PR4 CMB power spectra and lensing maps via healpy, with CAMB-generated fallback spectra and likelihood summaries.

nodes.name: download_sdss.py
nodes.summary: Downloads SDSS DR17/DR18 quasar and SDSS black-hole-mass catalogs via astroquery SkyServer queries.

nodes.name: download_strain_marquee.py
nodes.summary: Downloads 4 kHz 4096-s strain HDF5 files for marquee events GW170817, GW190814, and GW190521 with SHA-verified filenames.

nodes.name: download_sxs.py
nodes.summary: Downloads/builds the SXS numerical-relativity waveform catalog: metadata, synthetic waveform NPZ generation where the JS catalog blocks direct download, and a usage guide.

nodes.name: download_xray_binaries.py
nodes.summary: Downloads X-ray binary catalog metadata and model data for MAXI, Swift/BAT, NICER surveys, noting that live HEASARC API pulls can be restricted.

nodes.name: make_notebook.py
nodes.summary: Nbformat generator script that authors notebooks/01 (first theoretical model) from embedded markdown/code cells.

nodes.name: make_notebook2.py
nodes.summary: Extended Models notebook (02) generator: geodesics, ISCO, wormhole throat, Hawking radiation.

nodes.name: make_notebook3.py
nodes.summary: Data Exploration notebook (03) generator over GWOSC/HEASARC catalogs.

nodes.name: make_notebook4.py
nodes.summary: White Hole Instability notebook (04) generator with toy decay model.

nodes.name: make_notebook5.py
nodes.summary: Equation Derivations notebook (05) generator with SymPy verification.

nodes.name: make_notebook6.py
nodes.summary: Visual Models notebook (06) generator with Plotly 3D exports.

nodes.name: make_notebook7.py
nodes.summary: Geodesic Simulations notebook (07) generator using EinsteinPy.

nodes.name: make_notebook8.py
nodes.summary: SymPy Christoffel notebook (08) generator for Schwarzschild and Morris-Thorne metrics.

nodes.name: make_notebook9.py
nodes.summary: White Hole Extended notebook (09) generator.

nodes.name: make_notebook10.py
nodes.summary: Complete Theory notebook (10) generator; imports the models package so the notebook matches the code.

nodes.name: make_notebook11.py
nodes.summary: Data Synthesis notebook (11) generator combining GWTC, AGN, and stellar-BH catalogs.

nodes.name: make_notebook12.py
nodes.summary: Advanced Models notebook (12) generator (Penrose, superradiance, Kerr).

nodes.name: make_notebook13.py
nodes.summary: White Hole Deep Dive notebook (13) generator.

nodes.name: make_premium_figures.py
nodes.summary: Generates the premium HTML figure set (mass distributions, ISCO, correlations) with Plotly, reading the processed catalogs.

nodes.name: process_blackcat.py
nodes.summary: Parses and joins the published BlackCAT CDS/VizieR tables into a clean dynamical black-hole mass sample CSV.

nodes.name: update_gwosc_gwtc5.py
nodes.summary: Refreshes the full GWOSC GWTC catalog snapshot (GWTC-1..GWTC-5, 391 events): raw JSON dump, tidy per-event CSV, catalog stats with fetch timestamps and content hashes.

nodes.name: verify_formulas.py
nodes.summary: Verification driver: executes models/derivations.run_all() asserting every symbolic check, runs numeric spot checks against closed forms, and writes reports/derivations_report.md plus results/derivation_checks.json.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs all symbolic derivation checks plus numeric spot checks and writes the derivation report artifacts.

nodes.name: theory.tex
nodes.summary: Standalone LaTeX theory manuscript covering the spacetime solutions and derivations used across the premium theory documents.

layers.name: Theory Library
layers.description: The 13 premium LaTeX theory documents (black holes, charged/rotating solutions, Christoffel symbols, geodesics, Raychaudhuri, Fisher matrix, perturbation theory, wormholes, white holes, early SMBH growth, quantum gravity) plus THEORY.md and theory.tex — the derivations backbone of the project.

layers.name: Project Documentation & Reports
layers.description: README overview and the auto-generated reports: project summary, GWTC snapshot status, compute-with-data results, and the derivation verification report.

layers.name: Physics Model Package
layers.description: The importable models package: equations.py (astropy-unit closed forms), formulas.py (extended formulas citing derivations), derivations.py (Sympy symbolic derivations with checks), and the package init.

layers.name: Computational Notebooks
layers.description: 24 execution notebooks: fundamentals through complete theory (01-13), fast scientific-profile notebooks (REBOUND, EinsteinPy, yt, GW, ML, strain — 14-19), and catalog/analysis notebooks (GWTC remnants, AGN masses, BlackCAT, early SMBH growth, quantum gravity — 20-24).

layers.name: Data Pipelines & Verification
layers.description: 36 scripts: source downloads (GWOSC, HEASARC, BlackCAT, EHT, Gaia, Planck, SDSS, SXS, strain, GWB), catalog processing, derived-quantity augmentation, dashboard builders, notebook/figure generators, GWTC refresh, and the formula verification driver.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: README defines the object catalog (black holes, wormholes, white holes), the data sources, and the layout of data/models/notebooks/premium. reports/summary.md then rolls up catalog counts (391 GWTC events), the implemented model inventory, and next steps.

tour.title: Core Physics Models
tour.description: models/equations.py provides the astropy-unit closed forms (Schwarzschild radius, Hawking temperature, Morris-Thorne metric); formulas.py extends with exact Kerr ISCO and Eddington limits; derivations.py derives everything symbolically in SymPy with explicit checks.

tour.title: Theory Library
tour.description: The premium theory set derives each spacetime family completely: theory_black_holes (Schwarzschild from first principles), Kerr-Newman and ADM masses, Reissner-Nordstrom, the 48 Christoffel symbols, geodesics with Carter constant, and the Raychaudhuri equation.

tour.title: Data Refresh Pipeline
tour.description: Scripts rebuild the observational snapshot: update_gwosc_gwtc5.py refreshes the full GWTC-1..GWTC-5 catalog (391 events), download_heasarc.py and download_blackcat.py pull REM/CV catalogs, and process_blackcat.py + add_bh_derived_quantities.py produce the processed CSVs.

tour.title: Compute & Verify With Data
tour.description: compute_with_data.py reconciles the catalog (chirp-mass and redshift recomputation, mass-gap candidates) and quicklooks marquee-event strain; verify_formulas.py executes every symbolic derivation and numeric spot check, writing reports/derivations_report.md.

tour.title: Dashboards & Figures
tour.description: Dashboard builders turn processed CSVs into reproducible Plotly HTML: GWTC remnants, AGN reverberation masses, and BlackCAT dynamical masses (limits kept as limits); create_animations.py and make_premium_figures.py add the visual layer.

tour.title: Notebook Suite
tour.description: The 24 notebooks carry the analysis narrative: fundamentals (01), extended models (02), derivations with SymPy (05), complete theory (10), then fast scientific-profile notebooks (14-19) and catalog notebooks (20-24) backed by the processed data.

tour.title: Frontier Topics
tour.description: The frontier modules: 23_early_smbh_growth.ipynb with its premium companion quantify the feasibility of early SMBH seeds under Eddington-limited growth with explicit selection caveats; 24_quantum_gravity.ipynb and its companion separate measured fact, derived algebra, and illustration.
